lines.lyric: Han beonjeum geureon jeok itjana
lines.lyric_hangul: 한 번쯤 그런 적 있잖아
lines.lyric_translation: You did this once before

lines.lyric: Nunman bwado da al suga itneun
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈만 봐도 다 알 수가 있는 (whoa, yeah)
lines.lyric_translation: Only by looking at your eyes I can tell

lines.lyric: Mwol eojjeona shipdagado
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭘 어쩌나 싶다가도?
lines.lyric_translation: Whatever may happen

lines.lyric: I gamjeongeul algo shipeungeol
lines.lyric_hangul: 이 감정을 알고 싶은걸 (oh)
lines.lyric_translation: I want to know this emotion

lines.lyric: Georeul ttae by my side
lines.lyric_hangul: 걸을 때 by my side (side)
lines.lyric_translation: When walking by my side

lines.lyric: Kkwak jabeun sondo nochigo shipjiga ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 꽉 잡은 손도 놓치고 싶지가 않아
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t even want to let go of your hands

lines.lyric: Seolleneun gibuneun da neoraseo maeu joa da
lines.lyric_hangul: 설레는 기분은 다 너라서 매우 좋아 다
lines.lyric_translation: That flattering feeling is because of you, everything is so good

lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 뭘 바라야 하니? 내 맘은 이미 충분히
lines.lyric_translation: What should I wish for honey / My heart is enough

lines.lyric: Neoro neoro kkwak kkwak cha itne
lines.lyric_hangul: 너로 너로 꽉 꽉 차 있네
lines.lyric_translation: It’s fully filled by you

lines.lyric: This feels so right
lines.lyric_hangul: This feels so right (so right)
lines.lyric_translation: This feels so right

lines.lyric: Neoman isseumyeon da modeun ge joa
lines.lyric_hangul: 너만 있으면, 다 모든 게 좋아
lines.lyric_translation: Everything is good when just you are here

lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 나에게 쉴 새 없이 꿀 떨어지는 damage야
lines.lyric_translation: You’re not going to stop me / You’re like continuous damage to me

lines.lyric_hangul: 철없이 아플 거야 난 (아야, 아야, 아야)
lines.lyric_translation: I’m gonna be hurt childishly / Ouch, ouch, ouch

lines.lyric_hangul: 'Cause you, you're my everything, 우린 알맞아

lines.lyric_hangul: 'Cause you, you're my everyday, 너도 알잖아
lines.lyric_translation: Cause you, you’re my everyday / You also know it

lines.lyric: Nan nega piryohae, neon naega piryohae
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 네가 필요해, 넌 내가 필요해
